decision: A remembered composition can evolve across data, permissions, behavior graph, and presentation, then regenerate Angular and ReactJS without losing human-owned extensions or changing the platform core during that regeneration.

permissions.required_runtime_effect: The generated execution boundary denies the command when support.submit is absent.

slots.invariant: Content and hash survive regeneration byte-for-byte.

invariants: One canonical evolved composition is consumed by both target renderers.
Angular and ReactJS renderers remain strictly separated.
Human-owned extension content survives regeneration byte-for-byte.
Generator-owned artifacts may be replaced only after drift and ownership checks.
The evolution run itself does not modify core, planner, profiles, or renderers.

promotion_rule.blocking_when: All expected gaps have been implemented and removed from this contract.
promotion_rule.success: expected_gaps is empty and every invariant is verified by executable oracles.
